name: Oil Pressure
definition: Engine oil pressure is critically low. Continued running can destroy bearings and the engine. Stop safely and check oil level before restarting.
causes: Faulty oil pressure sensor or wiring
solutions: Stop the engine as soon as it is safe
Check dipstick and top up to the correct level if low
Do not keep driving if the light stays on after a correct fill
Have oil pressure tested mechanically if the light returns
Address pump, filter, or bearing faults before further operation
urgencyNote: Stop driving. Low oil pressure can cause rapid catastrophic engine damage.

faq.question: Can I drive with the oil pressure light on?
faq.answer: No. Shut the engine off when safe. Check oil level. If the light stays on with correct level, have the vehicle towed.
